detail.rawHint: Sensitive fields (signatures, tokens, keys) are masked.

outbox.intro: Each financial event (invoice issued, payment recorded) creates a customer notification and queues webhooks. The background worker runs every minute; "Retry" only puts a failed or stuck event back in the queue right away.
outbox.retryConfirm: Put event {id} back in the queue for immediate reprocessing?
outbox.retried: Event {id} requeued. The background worker will pick it up within a minute.
outbox.retryHint: Retrying never duplicates: notifications and webhooks already created are not created again.
outbox.notRetryable: This event is already processed or waiting for its first run; no retry needed.

webhooks.retryConfirm: Resend {event} to {name}? The delivery is queued with 3 fresh attempts.
webhooks.retried: Resend queued. The outcome appears in the log after the next delivery run.
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Generate a new signing secret for {name}? The old secret stops working immediately; the receiver must switch to the new secret to verify signatures.
webhooks.createSecretHint: Copy this secret before creating — once saved, only a masked value is shown.

secret.title: New webhook signing secret
secret.intro: New signing secret for "{name}". Use it to verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature header on every webhook.
secret.label: New signing secret
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the value and copy it manually.
secret.warning: This secret is shown only once. After closing this dialog it cannot be viewed again — if lost, rotate it again.
